vulnerability.name: USN-7135-1
vulnerability.description: Bahruz Jabiyev, Anthony Gavazzi, Engin Kirda, Kaan Onarlioglu, Adi Peleg, and Harvey Tuch discovered that HAProxy incorrectly handled empty header names. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to manipulate headers and bypass certain authentication checks and restrictions.

statements.status_notes: HAProxy could allow unintended access to network services. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
